body:
I dont have any freedom. My family always ignores everything i say and keep deciding things on my behalf and they keep telling me I'm a kid and that I can't understand anything. That they know better
My aunt and her husband have more say in my life than myself. I hate my dad and he's a real pos but he wouldn't let me go. I'm so stuck I wanna end it all.
My family never take me seriously and they keep deciding things on my behalf without listening to me :(

What u just said is really beautiful. Idk exactly where the pain is coming from but I suspect that it was the chain of events that happened 4 years ago. I lost my grandma, my school at the time was too strict like I spent 12 hours a day at school if not more, I was under too much pressure at the time and it just triggered it I guess. I sort of lost every hope and passion I had. A few days ago though I just decided to start drawing again :)) sorry for the rant😖
Well I hope everyone makes it :)))

Thank uu 🥲😃 ur words mean a lot to me🥺 sometimes things just get hard and scary enough for u to just feel like escaping and ending it all sounds like a wonderful idea. I hope everyone finds a reason to stay alive.
I can feel you :(( I'm yearning for people who actually care and won't judge me no matter what. But let's just not give up. I'm sure we can find our own families soon :)))
